method.p_up: committed probability the target prints before the kill, within the horizon
method.p_now: ln(px/kill)/ln(target/kill): gambler's-ruin probability from today's price
method.drift: p_now − p_up; a learning signal for open forecasts, never a score
method.brier: mean (p − outcome)²; lower is better; 0.25 = coin-flip at p=0.5
method.skill_vs_base: 1 − Brier(analyst)/Brier(base rate); > 0 means the analyst beats the library

judge.note: provisional until resolutions accumulate: a kill counts as right while the price drifts away from the analyst's target
